Choose what data to manage, then more options will appear. You can:

  1. specify a Type Name
    Radmin will get all items of this type. If you create a new item, it will be of this type.
  2. specify a Query
    Radmin will get the query and allow item edit. Create is not possible.
  3. specify both Type Name and Query
    Radmin will get the query, and also allow create-new of the type you specify.
